rules: Do not use the monolithic Engine 1.0 payload as the normal initial browser download.
Load bootstrap metadata first and one selected race-edition bundle on demand.
Keep route, elevation, map and replay assets lazy-loaded and keyed by course_version.
Do not expose SQLite, raw Sportstiming archives, source reports or research files to the frontend.
Cross-year views should use small precomputed aggregates or explicit on-demand shards rather than forcing all result records into the initial load.
Frontend code budgets are provisional until the real browser build exists; data budgets are enforceable immediately.
